text:
Alex: Heads-up: planning to enable feature flag `pii_audit_mode_v2` in prod as a 5% canary for EU enterprise tenants tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Need ops + security signoff on KMS/HSM fallback and retention guardrails.
Marta: quick q — does this change alter retention window or just add audit logging? If retention changes we need legal signoff.
Alex: just adds audit logs + HSM path support. retention toggle is separate (`pii_retention_days`) but want to coordinate enabling to avoid surprise. No retention change planned yet.
Ryan: pinging infra — KMS rotation might cause transient failures if keys are rolled during canary. @samir any thoughts?
Samir: noted. We have auto-rotate scheduled 2026-06-15 02:00 UTC in eu-west. Suggest either delay or ensure fallback to local HSM path. I'll add a pre-check that verifies key version mapping.
Sophia: can you paste the flag config + canary audience? Will add to runbook.
Alex: here:
```
feature_flag: pii_audit_mode_v2
enabled: true
canary: 5%
audience: "tenant.attributes.region == 'eu' && tenant.tier == 'enterprise'"
actions: ["log-pii", "kms-encrypt-audit"]
fallback: "use_hsm_path"
```
Marta: guardrails: ensure logs are PII-scrubbed before retention, add alert on >0.5% error rate, and require manual rollback if error spike. Also add metric for keys-unavailable.
Ryan: CR for runtime check-in: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/321 — comments left. @alex can you add test for key mismatch behavior?
Alex: will do, test plan below: small script to simulate KMS timeout -> expect fallback path. snippet:
```
# simulate
curl -X POST /internal/simulate_kms_failure -d '{"key":"pii_audit"}'
```
Samir: @deploy-bot — can we schedule a narrow canary window? please hold for manual kickoff.
deploy-bot: scheduled hold for rollout 1791300000, requires manual approve by deploy-ops.
Sophia: I'll draft runbook and remediation steps, include steps to disable `pii_audit_mode_v2` quickly (one-click toggle + db cleanup job).
Marta: ok from compliance to proceed if no retention changes. keep me looped. :+1:
Alex: thanks — will post final checklist and ping again when PRs merged. cc @ryan @samir
Ryan: LGTM on approach, will review PR today.
Samir: added preflight check to infra — link: https://internal.redwood/ops/checks/flag-preflight/45
Alex: final note: do NOT enable in us region yet; only eu canary.
